config/agents/builder.md sets the model for builder. The agent's frontmatter model, inherit included, beats CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, which beats the main model, unless CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE is on. A model passed at dispatch, or set by a mod's agent.spawn hook, beats the frontmatter, and the dashboard can't see either.

config/settings.json sets the model. --model beats ANTHROPIC_MODEL, which beats the model key in any file, managed included.
CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL sets the effort for reviewer. CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL beats the agent's effort frontmatter, which beats --effort and the settings that count for its own model.
